enabled.description:
If `true`, Kubernetes audit logs are collected.
and pushed into the SIEM system (e.g. logstash).
False by default.

secret_name.description: Contains the name of the Kubernetes secret in namespace kube-system with credentials of the SIEM system where logs should be pushed. Fields of the secret: host, port, username (optional), password (optional), ca.crt (optional). This field is optional. By default, used mks-audit-logs is used. Secret name should be as a DNS subdomain name as defined in RFC 1123. [More Information.](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#dns-subdomain-names)

OIDC.description: OIDC represents parameters to connect client's OIDC provider with Kubernetes.

client_id.description: Required client id that all tokens must be issued for. Will be placed in `--oidc-client-id` flag. It is required when enabled = true.

enabled.description:
If `enabled` OIDC should be turned on in the cluster.
False by default.

groups_claim.description: Optional JWT claim to use as the user's group. By default, `groups`. Will be placed in `--oidc-groups-claim` flag.

issuer_url.description: URL of the provider that allows the API server to discover public signing keys. Will be placed in `--oidc-issuer-url` flag. It is required when enabled = true.

provider_name.description: Custom user defined name of the provider. It is not used in the cluster directly. It is required when enabled = true.

username_claim.description: Optional JWT claim to use as the username. By default, `sub`. Will be placed in `--oidc-username-claim` flag.

ca_certs.description:
CACerts represent optional custom CA certs chain in X509 PEM format of provider's SSL certificate.
Will be written to file on masters which will be passed in `--oidc-ca-file` kube-apiserver flag.

ca_certs_expiration.description: CACertsExpiration represents date and time when the first of provided CA certificates will be expired.

KubernetesOptions.description:

admission_controllers.description: Turned on admission controllers for the cluster.

x509_ca_certificates.description: Represent custom X509 CA certificates which can be used for cluster components. Certificates should be encoded to base64 format. Note 💡 ``` X509CaCertificates can be disabled for some pools. ```

pool.description: Pool represents the pool where the cluster master nodes are located.

cni_type.description: CNI type represents type of CNI which is used in cluster.

CNICiliumSettings.description:
Settings for Cilium CNI if this CNI was chosen as "cni_type".
Otherwise settings will be ignored.

hubble_relay.description: Enables hubble relay for Cilium CNI.

envoy_daemonset.description: Enables Envoy DaemonSet for Cilium CNI.

additional_software.description:
AdditionalSoftware represents information about additional software installed in the cluster.
Deprecated: do not use.

basic.description:
Basic specifies that only a single zonal master will be created.
It is needed if a highly available control plane is not required.
False by default.

enable_patch_version_auto_upgrade.description:
EnablePatchVersionAutoUpgrade specifies whether the Kubernetes version of the cluster is allowed to be upgraded
automatically.
Enabled by default for regional clusters and disabled for zonal clusters.

enable_autorepair.description: EnableAutorepair reflects whether worker nodes are allowed to be reinstalled  automatically in case of their unavailability or unhealthiness.

kube_version.description:
KubeVersion represents the needed Kubernetes version of the cluster.
It should be in x.y.z format.

maintenance_window_start.description:
MaintenanceWindowStart represents UTC time of when the cluster will start its maintenance tasks.
It should be in hh:mm:ss format if provided.

name.description:
Name represents the desired name of the cluster.
It must not exceed 32 characters and can contain Latin letters,
with digits and hyphens. Must start with a letter or a digit.

network_id.description:
NetworkID contains a reference to the network of the cluster.
It can be set in cases where the network is pre-created.

network_type.description:
NetworkType indicates which network will be used for master-node
connection.

pool.description: Pool is the pool of where the cluster master nodes are located.

private_kube_api.description:
PrivateKubeAPI specifies whether kube API should be available from the Internet or not.
False by default.

subnet_id.description:
SubnetID contains a reference to the subnet of the cluster.
It can be set in cases where the subnet is pre-created.

cni_type.description:
CNI type represents type of CNI which will be used in cluster.
Supported CNI types are CALICO and CILIUM. CALICO by default.

cluster_type.description:
The type of the cluster. If not specified,
defaults based on the 'basic' field: basic=true → BASIC,
basic=false → HIGH_AVAILABILITY. For HIGH_AVAILABILITY_MULTI_AZ
clusters this field is required.
